DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancoast Tumor (Apical Lung Cancer) causing Thoracic Outlet Syndrome.

While the standard Chest X-ray and initial labs were normal, the combination of progressive arm weakness, significant weight loss, and your history of smoking strongly suggests a tumor at the lung apex compressing the brachial plexus.
